# vulnetix_ai_models (Data Source)

The AI models the AI firewall knows (`GET /ai-firewall/models`): every built-in provider's models and those of the tenant's custom providers (`vulnetix_ai_provider`). Use a model's `provider_slug` and `slug` to pin it in `vulnetix_ai_firewall_policy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every model the AI firewall knows whose slug or name mentions "sonnet".
data "vulnetix_ai_models" "sonnet" {
  search = "sonnet"
}

output "sonnet_models" {
  value = [for m in data.vulnetix_ai_models.sonnet.models : "${m.provider_slug}/${m.slug}" if m.is_active]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `provider_uuid` (String) Only this provider's models, by the provider's uuid.
- `search` (String) Only models whose slug or name contains this, ignoring case.

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) The matching models. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the provider still serves the model.
- `name` (String) The model's display name.
- `provider_slug` (String) The provider's slug, such as `anthropic` or a custom provider's name.
- `provider_uuid` (String) The provider's id.
- `released_at` (Number) When the model was released, in Unix milliseconds; 0 when unknown.
- `slug` (String) The model's slug, as requests name it.
- `uuid` (String) The model's id.
